subject.title: Route org publisher abuse nominations to org review

question: Should org publisher abuse nominations leave the user-ban enforcement path and be tracked for org/member review instead?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it changes a security-sensitive moderation workflow and is a draft MEMBER PR, so automation should not close or merge it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Continue maintainer review
options.body: Keep the PR open, review the org-level moderation policy, and merge through normal maintainer flow if the new lane is the intended behavior.

options.title: Request UI proof first
options.body: Ask for a real ClawHub management UI screenshot or browser proof of the org-review lane before undrafting.

options.title: Rework policy direction
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want org nominations to stay in a generic policy-discussion queue or use a different org suspension workflow.

recommendation.title: Continue maintainer review
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, review the org-level moderation policy, and merge through normal maintainer flow if the new lane is the intended behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: jesse-merhi has the most recent current-main work in publisher-abuse moderation and authored this policy implementation.
